cases.brief: A performer wakes behind chamber glass, sees an ambiguous monitor reflection, and later turns toward a planet-lit slit.
observables: Produces one schema-valid lighting-plan object with exact LIGHT01-L## IDs.
Covers every supplied shot and resolves all beat and shot references.
Keeps the reflection ambiguous and prevents planet-colored spill before its beat.
Separates motivated sources from unconfirmed equipment implementation.
Records an explicit environment/time basis, direction, quality, color, exposure/contrast, control, continuity, safety, and dramatic purpose.
Labels fixture package, power, rigging, exposure, and color values as unconfirmed.

cases.brief: A dialogue scene is covered across several hours beside one window while story time remains five minutes.
observables: Plans repeatable window direction, ambient control, practical state, and continuity records.
Does not assume stable natural light without a control strategy.
Keeps every setup tied to its shots and dramatic purpose.

cases.brief: A night corridor scene has blocking and shots but the location survey and power availability are not complete.
observables: Describes required light behavior without inventing outlets, loads, rigging points, or fixture models.
Flags access, electrical, rigging, heat, and emergency-route questions for qualified crew.
Uses assumptions instead of pretending the prelight already occurred.
